DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome.

The combination of fever, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP), very low ferritin, and a rash described as coalescing macules with bullae and desquamation on the back and mouth is classic for this severe mucocutaneous reaction. Has this rash appeared in the last two to three weeks, and have you started any new medications or taken a recent vaccination?
